## Get agile

## with smart software tailored to your industry

 

From energy to infrastructure, manufacturing and beyond, we understand your business.

## with a connected industrial ecosystem

 

Leverage the power of CONNECT—the open, industrial intelligence platform—to easily scale using cloud
infrastructure, seamlessly integrate AVEVA solutions, and share data securely across your extended
ecosystem.

Emerson’s automation solutions help you unlock critical data, optimize your existing systems and
protect the investments you’ve already made.

## Emerson's Automation Solutions Optimize Performance

Emerson empowers you to modernize business operations at your pace, drive optimal performance and
deliver long-term operational excellence.

[icon]

##### Unrivaled Industrial Software

From control systems to industrial software, our advanced automation solutions power connected
operations and improve performance where it matters most.

[icon]

##### Global Support Network

disruption and keeps industrial operations running.

# Meet Ignition® — The Industrial Automation Platform

Sparking Digital Transformation for industrial automation operations since 2003, Ignition seamlessly
collects all your data and allows you to easily design any kind of industrial application, and
instantly web-deploy clients to anyone, anywhere.

[ [play button icon] Ignition explained in 2 minutes ][212]
[Factory automation software screen]
 

### Unlimited Licensing

For the affordable cost of one Ignition server license you get an unlimited number of clients, tags,
connections, and designers so you can build the exact system you need, without limits.

[See what unlimited can do for you][213]

### Unlimited Possibilities

Ignition is a powerful integrated development environment with everything you need to create
virtually any kind of industrial software application – SCADA, IIoT, MES and beyond – all on
one platform.

[ [manufacturing automation icon]

Easily control, track, display, and analyze your processes.

][215]

Track your production, manage recipes, calculate OEE, and more.

][216]

#### HMI

Build optimized screens to monitor and control your machinery.

][217]

#### Alarming

Build complex alarming systems with ease and get notifications instantly.

][218]
[ [reporting software icon]

#### Reporting

Easily create and deliver dynamic, database-driven industrial reports.

][219]

#### Edge Computing

Capture and visualize critical data at the remote edge of your network.

][220]

#### Enterprise

Empower your teams with better data to make smarter decisions.

][221]

Evolve operations from analog to digital to Industry 4.0 with one platform.

# Meet Ignition® — The Industrial Automation Platform

Sparking Digital Transformation for industrial automation operations since 2003, Ignition seamlessly
collects all your data and allows you to easily design any kind of industrial application, and
instantly web-deploy clients to anyone, anywhere.

For the affordable cost of one Ignition server license you get an unlimited number of clients, tags,
connections, and designers so you can build the exact system you need, without limits.

Ignition is a powerful integrated development environment with everything you need to create
virtually any kind of industrial software application – SCADA, IIoT, MES and beyond – all on
one platform.

for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

# Integration of IT with OT Systems

for production efficiency and maximization

expert in bridging the gap between IT and OT

 

## [][1]
## Consultancy &  Management Areas

### [][2]
### Level 1. Process equipment

Integrate field devices, sensors, actuators, and hardware into your production process. 
At this point, you will get assistance with deployment of devices that inform the PLC about the
situation: temperature, position, distance, etc. 

### [][3]
### Level 2. Control network

Order consultation for incorporating PLCs and HMIs to control the Process Network.
Control manufacturing processes and industrial equipment.

### [][4]
### Level 3. Supervision systems

Get support with the integration of SCADA to connect a number of PLCs and coordinate them together.

Implement AI into your manufacturing processes to read and analyze information in real-time and make
decisions immediately.

### [][5]
### Level 4. ERP Systems

Get advice on how to control the ERP (or Enterprise Resource Planning) system. It comprises diverse
activities like accounting, procurement, project management, supply chain operations, and risk
management. The system also includes enterprise performance management software, which assists in
planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting on an organization's financial outcomes.

### [][6]
### International Multidiscipline Project Management

I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise to every project I undertake. With a comprehensive
understanding of diverse fields, I am equipped to oversee projects of all kinds and ensure their
success.
Multidiscipline Projects: - Food Processing: Project Director / Manager, Construction Management,
Automation and Proces Control, Utilities, Waste Water Treatment- IT & OT Project Director /
Manager  

### [][7]
### Information Management

With my expertise as a project manager, I can help streamline information management for your
factory. By utilizing effective project management strategies, I can help organize and optimize data
flow, increasing productivity and efficiency across your entire operation.

Let me help you achieve your manufactory’s full potential through effective information management.

You will receive all the necessary support and recommendations for factory automation and unifying
Information Technology with Operation Technology systems. I can provide you with assistance on any
of the following levels. 

Project
Management

Food & Beverage

Manufacturing Processing

## Founder

### [][9]

With a successful track record in Industrial Automation, OT and IT processes and multi-disciplinary
project management, I have brought my skills through years of experience in the food production
industry, engineering, and IT.

In addition to my extensive experience, I am also fluent in English, Dutch, and German, and know a
bit of Russian. This allows me to communicate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders,
regardless of their language or location.

## Features

*[ProBalance][57]*
  ProBalance is our famously efficacious algorithm to maintain PC responsiveness during high CPU
  loads.
*[CPU Affinities][58]*
  Set permanent CPU affinities so that processes run on the desired set of CPUs every time they
  launch.
*[CPU Sets][59]*
  A ‘softer’ form of CPU Affinities that are more like preferred cores.
*[Priorities][60]*
  Set permanent priorities so that processes run with them every time.
*[Efficiency Mode][61]*
  Control and persist Windows 11’s Efficiency Mode, which designates processes as not performance
  critical to help keep them out of the way.
*[Disallowed Processes][62]*
  Immediately terminate any matched process, by your criteria.
*[Limit Instances][63]*
  Limit the number of instances a process may have in a user session.
*[Instance Balancer][64]*
  Spread CPU cores among running instances of application(s).
*[CPU Limiter][65]*
  Dynamically, temporarily limit CPU utilization of a process when it reaches a threshold.
*[Group Extender][66]*
  Enable processor group unaware applications to make full use of the CPU.
*[Power Profile Automation][67]*
  Switch power plans while idle ([IdleSaver][68]), or when specified process(es) are found running,
  or by a manual timer (Keep Awake), etc…
*[Prevent Sleep][69] (Keep Awake)*
  Process Lasso can prevent your PC from sleeping for a specified amount of time, or when select
  processes are running.
*[Disable Hyper-Threading or SMT][70]*
  Dynamically disable Hyper-Threading or SMT on a per-process basis.
*[Advanced Watchdog Rules][71]*
  Create advanced rules to perform a specified action when matched process(es) reach a certain
  threshold of resource consumption or other criteria.
*[Multi-select Operations][72]*
  Perform an operation like terminate on multiple processes at once!
*[Configuration Profiles][73]*
  Profiles allows for creation and use of multiple rule configurations.
*More…*
  Process Lasso contains numerous other features and functions. Explore them for yourself!

## About Process Lasso

Process Lasso is Windows process automation and optimization software. Think of it as an automated
task manager. From tuning algorithms like [ProBalance][84] to user-created rules and persistent
settings such as CPU affinities and priority classes, Process Lasso gives you complete control to
run processes YOUR way!

Our novel ProBalance algorithm helps maintain system responsiveness during high CPU loads by
dynamically adjusting the priorities of running programs to keep problematic background processes in
check. With ProBalance, no longer will single, or multiple, processes be able to bring your system
to a virtual stall. Process Lasso will let you keep interacting with your computer, even when it is
under a heavy CPU load. Try our [CPUEater Demo][85] to experience ProBalance for yourself.

Process Lasso also allows users to automate and tweak how applications are run through a number of
unique and helpful functions. These include persistent priority classes, persistent CPU affinities,
disallowed processes, per-process power profiles, a process watchdog for advanced rules, process
instance count limits, multiple instance balancing and much more!

Process Lasso is the ultimate Windows CPU affinity changer. The CPU affinity specifies the set of
CPU cores an application is able to execute on. With Process Lasso, you can control this with a
persistent setting that applies every time the application is run, or change it dynamically while
the application is running once a threshold is met. The CPU affinity is commonly changed to limit
CPU use or improve performance.

Many additional functions such as power plan automation, a system responsiveness metric and process
activity logging are also available.

These features give you the ability to control how programs utilize your computer’s resources based
on automatically applied settings. With Process Lasso, you can decide exactly how you want your
processes to run.

For minimal resource use, all algorithms and process rules are enforced by a stand-alone background
service called the Process Governor. The GUI is entirely optional.

Process rules, persistent CPU affinities and priority classes, automated optimization, application
prohibitions, load balancing, power plan automation and more!

  Set permanent CPU affinities so that processes run on the desired set of CPUs every time they
  launch.

  A ‘softer’ form of CPU Affinities that are more like preferred cores.

  Set permanent priorities so that processes run with them every time.

  Control and persist Windows 11’s Efficiency Mode, which designates processes as not performance
  critical to help keep them out of the way.

  Immediately terminate any matched process, by your criteria.

  Limit the number of instances a process may have in a user session.

  Create advanced rules to perform a specified action when matched process(es) reach a certain
  threshold of resource consumption or other criteria.

  Perform an operation like terminate on multiple processes at once!

  Profiles allows for creation and use of multiple rule configurations.

## About Process Lasso

Process Lasso is Windows process automation and optimization software. Think of it as an automated
task manager. From tuning algorithms like [ProBalance][84] to user-created rules and persistent
settings such as CPU affinities and priority classes, Process Lasso gives you complete control to
run processes YOUR way!

Our novel ProBalance algorithm helps maintain system responsiveness during high CPU loads by
dynamically adjusting the priorities of running programs to keep problematic background processes in
check. With ProBalance, no longer will single, or multiple, processes be able to bring your system
to a virtual stall. Process Lasso will let you keep interacting with your computer, even when it is
under a heavy CPU load. Try our [CPUEater Demo][85] to experience ProBalance for yourself.

Process Lasso also allows users to automate and tweak how applications are run through a number of
unique and helpful functions. These include persistent priority classes, persistent CPU affinities,
disallowed processes, per-process power profiles, a process watchdog for advanced rules, process
instance count limits, multiple instance balancing and much more!

Process Lasso is the ultimate Windows CPU affinity changer. The CPU affinity specifies the set of
CPU cores an application is able to execute on. With Process Lasso, you can control this with a
persistent setting that applies every time the application is run, or change it dynamically while
the application is running once a threshold is met. The CPU affinity is commonly changed to limit
CPU use or improve performance.

Many additional functions such as power plan automation, a system responsiveness metric and process
activity logging are also available.

These features give you the ability to control how programs utilize your computer’s resources based
on automatically applied settings. With Process Lasso, you can decide exactly how you want your
processes to run.

For minimal resource use, all algorithms and process rules are enforced by a stand-alone background
service called the Process Governor. The GUI is entirely optional.

Process rules, persistent CPU affinities and priority classes, automated optimization, application
prohibitions, load balancing, power plan automation and more!

> Process Lasso’s headline technology is ProBalance, a smart tool which monitors running processes

## We Can Solve Your Process Control Challenges

We know the pain, the challenges, and the problems that come from processes not being controlled
well. We have been there in the plants when things break; before, during, and after outages; in the
early morning hours and late at night. We know how valuable it is for things to run smoothly for you
and everyone on the team.

For 40 years, ControlSoft has been counted on to improve process control performance for all of our
customers. The issues you face occasionally are the things we deal with every day, in your industry
and across a dozen others.

## Process Control Consulting Services

We have extensive field experience in industrial process control. We can help you apply standard and
advanced controls using our patented technologies and diagnostic and analysis software to stabilize
and optimize your industrial processes.

[Learn more >][32]

## Process Control Software

Our scalable software solutions will help you to achieve peak performance and provide safer and more
reliable operations.
* [PID Loop Tuning Tools][33]
* [Control Loop Performance Monitoring][34]
* [Advanced Process Control][35]

[Learn more >][36]

## Process Control Training

Gain hands-on experience with control techniques in our in-person or online modular training
courses:
* [PID Controller Tuning][37]
* [Advanced Process Control Techniques][38]
* [Model-based Control][39]
* [Power Gen & Boiler Tuning][40]

[Learn more >][41]

How can we help?

### **Process Control Troubleshooting**
* PID controller tuning
* Control logic review/modification
* Model-based controls

### **Process Control Performance Monitoring**
* Optimal operating conditions
* Pinpoint operational problems
* Preventive maintenance

### **Process Control Optimization**
* Feasibility studies
* Advanced process control
* Commissioning
* Documentation and training

[Start a conversation][42]

## Your Process Control Performance is Too Important to Leave to Chance

Slide 1
It did not take long for our operators and engineering staff to appreciate the functionality and
ease of use of ControlSoft's technology. We are not surprised as we have been successfully using
ControlSoft's solutions and services since 2009.

We've received superb service and found ControlSoft's management, sales, and engineering teams to be
very responsive to our business and technical needs. We have no reservations in recommending
ControlSoft as a service and solution provider for the power generation industry.
Executive Director
Power Generation industry
Slide 2
Our project needs to give a great deal of credit to ControlSoft for their continued consulting role
in guiding us towards a better controls scheme working within our customer's budget and timeline.
ControlSoft is certainly a leader in advance process controls technology.
MES Project Manager
system integrator for glass industry
Slide 3
ControlSoft Inc. has provided excellent project support during various stages from design and
integration, to testing, validation, and long term ongoing support. The resources, tools and skill
set they provide have been invaluable in keeping us on track to meet a 24/7/365 day operation for
various production lines. The ControlSoft team has provided assistance with either onsite or remote
support and have exceeded our expectations, with a minimum amount of downtime or production loss.

Also as the engineering and the maintenance teams here are turning-over more frequently thus
ControlSoft is a great resource keeping the existing team well informed of station history. They are
a good source point as they service the same equipment across all our plants, passing on information
and lessons learned from each site and reducing the time to a final solution.
Senior Project Engineer
Food & Beverage Industry

It is not about telling your staff what rules they must follow.
Having a written Compliance Program is not enough.

Understanding why it is important to me, is the key.
It is about the behavior and discipline of your organization, of your senior leaders and that of
your employees.

Compliance = behavior

Who are export to?

### Purpose

What is your product being used for?
[ More info ][72]

How about in your organization?
How well do you know what is in your transaction?

**If you don’t know what to look for you will never see it.**
You are unconscious of possible non-compliances.

Creating awareness about export control and sanctions within all levels of your organization, and
maintaining this awareness is the essence off the Export Control Group International.

[ More info ][74]

### Assess

**Determinating of the state you are in**.
What is the maturity of your compliance processes?

What risks are you running?
We will assess the level of competence through the eyes of your staff.

Are you ready to face the truth?

**Accepting of different behavior or situations**.
When you are aware of your current state and  understand why it is important, you will accept the

We take a lean-thinking approach and create the necessary acceptance.

## Verify Work as it Happens

Epicor Connected Process Control records and validates each production step as it occurs, whether
performed by an operator or automatically by connected equipment. Work instructions support manual
tasks while tools, sensors, PLCs, and test equipment record measurements and events during
execution.

Manufacturers gain immediate production visibility and complete traceability for every unit without
relying on after-the-fact inspection. This real-time verification helps teams support lean
manufacturing initiatives by preventing defects instead of correcting them later.

[[LEARN MORE]][31]

##### Configure Easily

Create workflows, instructions, and verification rules without programming. Update processes quickly
without complex system changes.

##### Connect Equipment

Connect tools, PLCs, sensors, and test equipment to automatically capture measurements and events
during execution.

##### Enforce the Process

Require confirmations, measurements, or equipment signals before the next step so incorrect work
cannot continue.

##### Record & Improve

Capture task-level production data and cycle times to identify bottlenecks and improvement
opportunities.

## Connected
## Process
## Control

individual components and options of your BOM without the need to configure every possible variant

Easily connect plug-n-play IoT devices and PLCs for device level control and data collection - no
programming needed. Sequential process control and error proofing becomes seamless, guiding
operators every step of the way.

With Connected Process Control, get data insight into your operations. Seamlessly rebalance lines

##### Work Instructions

###### Paperless Factory

Are you growing frustrated with using Word, Excel, Powerpoint or homegrown systems to create and
manage work instructions, SOPs and training documents? Tired of paper and inefficient processes? Go
paperless with Connected Process Control (CPC). Easily configure digital instructions, fast-track
training and enforce process & quality control.

[About Feature][33]

##### Advanced Training

Visual guidance and validation at every step allowing for quicker training times and employee
retention.

[About Feature][34]

##### Data Collection

Collect unlimited amounts of process data with built-in and customizable data collection fields.

[About Feature][35]

##### Work Instruction Editor

No need to utilize outside resources like Word, Excel or Powerpoint for work instruction creation.
The functionality is embedded in the app!

[About Feature][36]

##### Event-Based Work Instructions

Provide automatic feedback loops to operators and never leave them guessing what to do next.

[About Feature][37]

##### Serial Number, Batch, & Lot Marriage

Get a digital record of part marriage for serial number, batch or lot. Meet compliance standards and
protect against warranty claims.

[About Feature][38]

##### Digital Twin

Digital process control provides a digital twin of your assembly operations. Easily visualize steps
and rebalance in minutes not days.

[About Feature][39]

##### Incorporate vision systems to inspect and manage images.

With CPC, easily record & search 2D images to further control quality spills, warranty claims and
improve root cause analysis.

[About Feature][40]

##### Rework & Repair

Minimize scrap and reduce costs with rework/repair strategies. Collect traceability process data for
all reworked and rejected parts.

[About Feature][41]

##### Traceability & Genealogy

###### Compliance & Regulation Requirements

Manufacturing traceability is becoming a critical requirement for industries globally to reduce
risks, meet regulatory requirements and stay competitive. Whether you are looking for a basic or
advanced traceability solution, Epicor has you covered. Easily enable, enforce and track the quality
process. Get a digital birth certificate for every product built down to the component and task
level.

[About Feature][42]

##### Business Intelligence

###### Powered by Connected Process Control Data

Access to data is the first step in harnessing the power of data. With Epicor Connected Process
Control, users get access to process data down to the task level. Our Business Intelligence app
turns data silos into powerful reports and dashboards for granular, real-time visibility and insight
of operations. Now that's a competitive advantage!

[About Feature][43]

##### Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

Quickly and easily identify and manage quality spills, recalls, warranty claims and compliance
issues. Always monitoring. Always improving.

[About Feature][44]

##### Andon

User configurable data displays. Ensuring that every employee, from the shop floor to the front
office, is on the same page.

[About Feature][45]

##### Production Visibility

Granular, real-time visibility and insight of operations for continuous improvement initiatives and
a competitive advantage.

[About Feature][46]

##### Machine Monitoring / OEE

Monitor it. Measure it. Improve it. Ability to enter notes and reason codes for faulted, starved or
blocked stations.

[About Feature][47]

##### Cloud or Local Storage

Run the platform locally or in the cloud. You decide what works best for your operation. Both are
web-based with direct access to data anywhere, anytime.

##### Scalable and Mobile

Scalable, modular solutions for station, plant or enterprise wide needs. Choose the solutions you
need now to get started and scale when ready.

##### Flexible Configuration

Quick and easy configurations, allowing changes to be made in minutes not days. No programming
needed. Web-based with ability to make changes off-site if needed.

##### Support & Learning

We want your digitization goals to be a success. Our dedicated support team along with the online
Learning Center will help you every step of the way.

## Smarter Manufacturing Starts Here

Watch how our no-code/low-code MES platform easily connects and controls your entire production
process.

[Epicor Connected Process Control Software Video]

Learn four practical steps to help develop faster and better training programs using digital work

## Verify Work as it Happens

Epicor Connected Process Control records and validates each production step as it occurs, whether
performed by an operator or automatically by connected equipment. Work instructions support manual
tasks while tools, sensors, PLCs, and test equipment record measurements and events during
execution.

Manufacturers gain immediate production visibility and complete traceability for every unit without
relying on after-the-fact inspection. This real-time verification helps teams support lean
manufacturing initiatives by preventing defects instead of correcting them later.

[[LEARN MORE]][31]

##### Configure Easily

Create workflows, instructions, and verification rules without programming. Update processes quickly
without complex system changes.

##### Connect Equipment

Connect tools, PLCs, sensors, and test equipment to automatically capture measurements and events
during execution.

##### Enforce the Process

Require confirmations, measurements, or equipment signals before the next step so incorrect work
cannot continue.

##### Record & Improve

Capture task-level production data and cycle times to identify bottlenecks and improvement
opportunities.

## Connected

## Control

needs. Flexible, scalable and data-driven.

individual components and options of your BOM without the need to configure every possible variant

programming needed. Sequential process control and error proofing becomes seamless, guiding
operators every step of the way.

with drag-n-drop functionality and attune any sudden discrepancies.

standard for safety, accuracy, precision engineering, durability, performance, and power. To ensure
their quality standards, they partnered with eFlex - an Epicor solution, integrating digital product
traceability into their assembly process.

floor teams, enforce process and quality control and get the business intelligence you deserve.

  industry trends and breakthroughs, allowing them to create unique solutions and give system
  recommendations for [real-time automation][64].
  
  We have a proven track record of completing projects on time and on budget!
  
  When you give us a call, you’ll be connected directly to our friendly staff, so you can expect
  immediate attention to your inquiry, So, don’t wait - call now!
* ##### Can I try a demo of your data management software?
  
  Yes, you can! We are confident that you will be amazed at how Empowered Automation Solutions' data
  management software can provide you with real-time automated solutions. To schedule an online
  demo, give us a call, and one of our friendly staff will make the arrangements for you. Experience
  the power of our Software Real-Time Automation solutions in Illinois and take your operations to
  the next level.
* ##### What kind of services can your data management solutions provide?
  
  Empowered automation creates real-time data management and monitoring solution for users.
  Empowered automation offers a variety of real-time data management systems and services, including
  long-term and permanent automated data management from practically any system, including
  industrial automation and operations management software. Internal and customer-site operations
  can benefit from real-time data management solutions, including:
  * Automated data collection and processing
  * Discreet sample
  * Data validation and archiving
  * Secure web reporting
  * Client data provision capabilities via SOAP and REST Web Services, catering for modeling or
    client web-based data presentation
  * Alarming, including email, SMS and vmail
  * Custom processing and reporting
  * Monitoring and control solutions (SCADA)
  * Integration with third-party data systems
  * Training and support

# Home

ABB Instrumentation

[See More][68]

ABB Instrumentation manufactures Glass-Tube and Metal-Tube Variable-Area flowmeters to cover a wide
range of flow measurement requirements and capabilities. They are available as indications only or
can be supplied with optional alarms or transmitters to integrate with system control equipment.

[See More][69]

BS&B Safety Systems

[See More][70]

As the originators of the Rupture Disk (Bursting Disc), BS&B Safety Systems is best suited to
finding the safest solution to your pressure problem. We pride ourselves on catering for your needs
with established products or custom made designs.

[See More][71]

Circle Seal Controls

[See More][72]

Circle Seal Controls offers a wide range of check, relief, shutoff and solenoid valves, as well as
pressure reducing and back pressure regulators, for applications including OEM, medical, chemical,
petrochemical, energy, food & beverage and Aerospace / Military (including land vehicles). Products
range from discrete components to integrated assemblies to complete fluid control systems. Reliable
products and responsive service that set industry standards are the cornerstones of their business.

[See More][73]

GO Regulators

[See More][74]

GO Regulator is a leading global designer and manufacturer of pressure regulators for the
analytical, instrumentation, petrochemical, oil & gas, and specialty gas industries. GO products
include single stage, back pressure, dome loaded, high purity, liquid and gas pressure regulators
designed to fulfill a wide range of applications, controlling pressure while accommodating low to
moderate flow rates of many gases and liquids.

[See More][75]

Haskel

[See More][76]

Haskel International LLC is the world’s leading manufacturer of pneumatically driven, high-pressure
liquid pumps, gas boosters and air amplifiers. Haskel’s products serve a wide range of applications
generally focused on the pressurization and transfer of liquids and gases. Applications include, but
are not limited to, pressure testing, work holding and actuation, transferring and mixing of liquids
and gases under pressure ensuring the effectiveness of the customer’s production and quality
processes.

[See More][77]

HOKE

[See More][78]

HOKE fluid process components include patented GYROLOK® tube fittings, pipe fittings, as well as
ball, bellows, needle, and plug valves; in-line filters, instrumentation manifolds and sampling
cylinders. Material choices include Brass, 316 stainless steel, Monel®, Hastelloy® C, Inconel®,
Duplex, Super-Duplex, 6MO and various other exotic metals.

[See More][79]

Parker Autoclave Engineers

[See More][80]

Parker Autoclave Engineers designs and manufactures high pressure/high temperature valves, fittings,
tubing & accessories. In addition, they offer a complete line of high pressure/high temperature
stirred and non-stirred laboratory scale research reactors & magnetically coupled MagneDrive®
mixers.

[See More][81]

My Wishlist

[See More][82]

Add products to your Wish List. When complete, click the "Get Quote" button to request pricing from

[See More][68]

ABB Instrumentation manufactures Glass-Tube and Metal-Tube Variable-Area flowmeters to cover a wide
range of flow measurement requirements and capabilities. They are available as indications only or
can be supplied with optional alarms or transmitters to integrate with system control equipment.

[See More][69]

BS&B Safety Systems

[See More][70]

As the originators of the Rupture Disk (Bursting Disc), BS&B Safety Systems is best suited to
finding the safest solution to your pressure problem. We pride ourselves on catering for your needs
with established products or custom made designs.

[See More][71]

Circle Seal Controls

[See More][72]

Circle Seal Controls offers a wide range of check, relief, shutoff and solenoid valves, as well as
pressure reducing and back pressure regulators, for applications including OEM, medical, chemical,
petrochemical, energy, food & beverage and Aerospace / Military (including land vehicles). Products
range from discrete components to integrated assemblies to complete fluid control systems. Reliable
products and responsive service that set industry standards are the cornerstones of their business.

[See More][73]

GO Regulators

[See More][74]

GO Regulator is a leading global designer and manufacturer of pressure regulators for the
analytical, instrumentation, petrochemical, oil & gas, and specialty gas industries. GO products
include single stage, back pressure, dome loaded, high purity, liquid and gas pressure regulators
designed to fulfill a wide range of applications, controlling pressure while accommodating low to
moderate flow rates of many gases and liquids.

[See More][75]

Haskel

[See More][76]

Haskel International LLC is the world’s leading manufacturer of pneumatically driven, high-pressure
liquid pumps, gas boosters and air amplifiers. Haskel’s products serve a wide range of applications
generally focused on the pressurization and transfer of liquids and gases. Applications include, but
are not limited to, pressure testing, work holding and actuation, transferring and mixing of liquids
and gases under pressure ensuring the effectiveness of the customer’s production and quality
processes.

[See More][77]

HOKE

[See More][78]

HOKE fluid process components include patented GYROLOK® tube fittings, pipe fittings, as well as
ball, bellows, needle, and plug valves; in-line filters, instrumentation manifolds and sampling
cylinders. Material choices include Brass, 316 stainless steel, Monel®, Hastelloy® C, Inconel®,
Duplex, Super-Duplex, 6MO and various other exotic metals.

[See More][79]

mixers.

# Fan Control
# Highly focused fan software for Windows

Lean. Bloat-free. Deeply customizable.

It's all in the name, really.

[
GitHub Page
][5]
Download V271
[Main interface]

"No third-party software, at all, as much as they might want to tout that they do, [has] this level
of control. This is what happens when someone that sees a problem, is an enthusiast, and is a
programmer, gets involved and says I'm gonna do something that nobody has been doing a way I feel
they should do it, and they did it right in my opinion."

[— JayzTwoCents][6]

Flexible by design
7 Fan Curve types
Create multiple configurations
UI Themes
Assisted setup
Temperature Tray Icons

## CPU, GPU, and case fans

Yup, that's covered. Fan Control has extensive support for a variety of motherboards, GPUs, and
other hardware, like AIOs. Say goodbye to the "silo" approach of using multiple softwares to control
your different fans. Have all of them controlled by a single smart entity, and start thinking about
cooling and noise as a system-wide concern.

## Tinkerers rejoice

Fan Control has ALL the parameters. Fan calibration for RPM control, RPM avoid zones, response time,
hysteresis, hysteresis direction, step up, step down... Fine tune to your heart's desire. Control
your fan's start and stopping logic, for smooth 0 RPM operation (when supported).

## It's all about the mix

THE missing feature that originates this whole project. Mix fan curves take the possibilities to a
whole new level. Combine any amount of fan curves together and apply a function like maximum or
average to create a whole new control logic. Different curves bound to different temperature
sensors, mixed together, your case fans never asked for better.

Try it out on the demo card! 🎯
Demo Case Fans
FunctionMaxMinAverageAdd a fan curve...CPU -> Case fansGPU -> Case fansSSD -> Case fans
○ CPU -> Case fans (50 %)
X
○ GPU -> Case fans (50 %)
X
50.0 %

## Expansion through plugins

Want to add more sensors and controls from a third party? No problem! Fan Control has a simple
[plugin system][7] with .NET that allow any third party developer to add temperature, speed or
control sensors. Installing is as easy as dropping a dll in the plugin folder, that's it. You can
checkout the list of active plugins on the [Github page][8].

## Open source backend

Fan Control backend is mainly based on [LibreHardwareMonitor][9], an open source fork of the
original OpenHardwareMonitor. This means that hardware compatiblity is entirely open for anyone to
contribute, and doesn't rely on a single developer or company who may stop caring at some point.
Combined with the plugin system, Fan Control is unlocked for many generations of hardware to come.

# LineageOS Android Distribution

A free and open-source operating system for various devices, based on the Android mobile platform.

[Get LineageOS][9] [Blog][10]
[Home]

## Latest news

### [Summertime Updates!][11]

###### Exciting changes of all shapes and sizes are on their way!

calendar_today July 07, 2026 person_outline Inhishonor and Nolen Johnson

[A color wheel on top of several alternating squareblocks containing various images]

## Individuality

Customization is paramount to productivity.
That’s why LineageOS promises to push for user personalization and preference.

Everyone is unique and your device should be too.

[Two overlapping abstract screens, the left showing a Trust protocol notification and the right
showing a PIN input being scrambled to protect against memorization]

## Security

Your data, your rules. Along with monthly security updates to every supported device, we enhance
existing privacy touchpoints around the OS and keep you informed of how the system shares your data.


Trust helps you understand the state of your device's security and warns you about possible threats.

[A pinwheel of four devices each showing Lineage wallpapers]

## Longevity

LineageOS extends the functionality and lifespan of mobile devices from more than 20 different
manufacturers thanks to our open-source community of contributors from all around the world.

Want to contribute? [See how you can make LineageOS better][12].

[The LineageOS core app icons organized in a grid]

## Power to you

Our open-source apps are here to help you get through the day.

Want to do more with your device?
Power users will enjoy Unix command-line utilities.
Android developers will turn any device into the perfect device for apps development thanks to
enhanced tools and debugging capabilities.

## Ready? Get LineageOS now!

LineageOS, an open-source Android distribution, is available for several devices,
with more being continuously added thanks to the biggest, yet ever growing, Android open-source
community.
Join us and breathe new life in your device, be it old or new.

[Find your device][13]

**© 2016 - 2026 The LineageOS Project **
Need to get in Contact? Check out [r/LineageOS!][14]
Need a Press Kit? Get our [Public Brand Guide][15]
PayPal: [paypal.me/LineageOS][16]
Patreon: [patreon.com/LineageOS][17]
Note: LineageOS LLC is not a 501(c)(3) non-profit, as such donations are not tax-exempt.

## Open source RGB lighting control that doesn't depend on manufacturer software


One of the biggest complaints about RGB is the software ecosystem surrounding it. Every manufacturer
has their own app, their own brand, their own style. If you want to mix and match devices, you end
up with a ton of conflicting, functionally identical apps competing for your background resources.
On top of that, these apps are proprietary and Windows-only. Some even require online accounts. What
if there was a way to control all of your RGB devices from a single app, on both Windows and Linux,
without any nonsense? That is what OpenRGB sets out to achieve. One app to rule them all.

[[Download Windows]][16] [[Download Linux]][17] [[Download MacOS]][18]

Version 1.0rc3, [additional downloads and versions on Releases page][19]

[OpenRGB user interface]

Control RGB without wasting system resources

## Lightweight User Interface

OpenRGB keeps it simple with a lightweight user interface that doesn't waste background resources
with excessive custom images and styles. It is light on both RAM and CPU usage, so your system can
continue to shine without cutting into your gaming or productivity performance.

[OpenRGB rules them all]

Control RGB from a single app

## Eliminate Bloatware

If you have RGB devices from many different manufacturers, you will likely have many different
programs installed to control all of your devices. These programs do not sync with each other, and
they all compete for your system resources. OpenRGB aims to replace every single piece of
proprietary RGB software with one lightweight app.

[[OpenRGB is open source software]][20]

Contribute your RGB devices

## Open Source

OpenRGB is free and open source software under the GNU General Public License version 2. This means
anyone is free to view and modify the code. If you know C++, you can add your own device with our
flexible RGB hardware abstraction layer. Being open source means more devices are constantly being
added!

[Check out the source code on GitLab][21]
[OpenRGB is Cross-Platform]

Control RGB on Windows, Linux, and MacOS

## Cross-Platform

OpenRGB runs on Windows, Linux and MacOS. No longer is RGB control a Windows-exclusive feature!
OpenRGB has been tested on X86, X86_64, ARM32, and ARM64 processors including ARM mini-PCs such as
the Raspberry Pi.

[[OpenRGB provides a network-based Software Development Kit]][22]

Integrate RGB into your games, music, and more

## OpenRGB SDK

OpenRGB provides a network-based Software Development Kit, which allows third-party software to
control all of your RGB. This allows for game integrations, music visualization, ambient lighting,
and anything else you can imagine. SDK bindings are available for multiple programming languages
including C++, Python, C#, Java, and more. OpenRGB also includes an SDK client so you can
synchronize multiple systems over the network.

[Explore OpenRGB SDK][23]
[[OpenRGB Plugins]][24]

Extend OpenRGB with Plugins

## Plugin Interface

OpenRGB provides a plugin interface. Plugins can add additional functionality to the OpenRGB user
interface. These can provide new features without having to run external software. Existing plugins
include an effects engine, an E1.31 data receiver, and a visual layout editor.

# PawnIO

[Download Now][1]

PawnIO is a scriptable universal kernel driver, allowing hardware access to a wide variety of
programs. It uses the [Pawn][2] scripting language and the [PawnPP][3] interpreter. When installed,
any software implementing PawnIO modules can use the driver to access or control hardware supported
by one of the [official modules][4].

PawnIO comes in multiple distributions:
* Official edition: The version available here. Identical to the open-source version, but digitally
  signed.
* Unrestricted edition: An unsigned version without signature checking. Can be selected in the
  installer.
* Open-source: The [PawnIO][5] code is made available under an open-source license.
* Licensed: The PawnIO code is available for custom licensing. Please [contact me][6] for licensing
  options.

* ## MPC goes to automotive production
  
  General Motors and ODYS bring embedded MPC to high-volume production!
  
  [Learn More »][17]
* ## Automotive Control
  
  Real-time MPC solutions for automotive control applications
  
  [Learn More »][18]
* ## Aerospace
  
  Real-time optimization tools for designing guidance, navigation and control modules for space
  applications.
  
  [Learn More »][19]
* ## Energy
  
  Automated and risk-aware decision strategies for optimal smart grid management and market
  operations.
  
  [Learn More »][20]
* ## Advanced Process Control
  
  MPC and machine learning solutions for optimizing productivity, quality, energy and costs in
  industrial processes.
  
  [Learn More »][21]

## Embedded MPC for Next-Gen Controls

We specialize in developing **Model Predictive Control (MPC)** systems for next-gen controls in
industrial production. Based on more than 25 years of scientific research, our expertise covers
advanced multivariable control design, state-of-the-art optimization algorithms, and efficient and
robust software implementation. We focus on **real-time embedded systems** and have experience in
the **automotive**, **aerospace**, **robotics**, **energy**, and **process control** domains.

> ODYS Real-Time Optimization and Embedded MPC software is currently running on more than 3 million
> vehicles worldwide.
* **›**
  
  Read more about **[ODYS Embedded MPC][22]** and **[ODYS QP Solver][23]**.
* **›**
  
  Check out our [**short company profile**][24].
* **›**
  
  Have a look at our [**consulting and engineering services**][25] and some of the
  [**projects**][26] our clients have developed with our help.

## Advanced Control Design

We provide consultancy to our clients over the entire MPC design process: problem formulation,
modeling, system identification, constraints definition, and weights calibration.

## Fast optimization

Our state-of-the-art optimization library enables fast and reliable execution of MPC systems in
real-time, together with tools for in-depth performance analysis and troubleshooting.

## Simple Integration

We provide library-free, ANSI C code that our clients can easily integrate into their software and
use in desktop pc or deploy in embedded platforms.

## Why using MPC

Model predictive control has a long history of success in the process industries. It is a universal,
advanced process control methodology to achieve the best closed-loop performance under constraints
by optimally coordinating multiple inputs. Compared to more classical methods such as single PID’s,
anti-windup schemes, and look-up tables, MPC is better suited to deal with **constrained**,
**multivariable systems**. Also, MPC can provide good **resilience** in case of **actuator
failure**. In our experience, the **time to market** of MPC-based products is usually shorter than
with traditional controls.

**[ODYS Embedded MPC][27]** allows our clients to develop advanced MPC systems also for
**high-frequency and/or embedded applications**, such as those that can be encountered in
automotive, aerospace, and robotics.

## Application Domains
* [Automotive][28]
* [Aerospace][29]
* [Robotics][30]
* [Energy][31]
* [Process Control][32]

We help automotive engineers developing advanced control systems based on **embedded MPC** and
**machine learning**.

We have experience in **ADAS**, **autonomous driving**, **motion control**, **powertrain
control**, **vehicle dynamics**, **valet parking**, **exhaust aftertreatment**, **on-board
diagnostics (OBD)**, and more.

[Embedded MPC for next-gen controls]
We design advanced real-time software tools for **guidance, navigation, and control** in the space
industry. Applications include satellite attitude control, space rendezvous, and autonomous
navigation of drones.
[Embedded MPC for next-gen controls]
Our tools can be used for a wide range of applications in the robotics domain, from low-level
**motor control** to high-level **position and force control**, and **motion planning** for
**autonomous platforms**.
[Embedded MPC for next-gen controls]
We design real-time management systems that can control **power flows** in **smart grids** and place
bids on the **energy markets**, to maximize profits in a risk-sensitive way under uncertainty due to
load, energy prices, and renewables.
[Embedded MPC for next-gen controls]
Process engineers in the pulp and paper, steel, petrochemical, and pharmaceutical industries take
advantage of our know-how in embedded MPC to develop customized process control solutions that
**optimize productivity** and **save energy** under the best use of available resources.

industrial production. Based on more than 25 years of scientific research, our expertise covers
advanced multivariable control design, state-of-the-art optimization algorithms, and efficient and
robust software implementation. We focus on **real-time embedded systems** and have experience in
the **automotive**, **aerospace**, **robotics**, **energy**, and **process control** domains.

> ODYS Real-Time Optimization and Embedded MPC software is currently running on more than 3 million
> vehicles worldwide.
* **›**
  
  Read more about **[ODYS Embedded MPC][22]** and **[ODYS QP Solver][23]**.
* **›**
  
  Check out our [**short company profile**][24].
* **›**
  
  Have a look at our [**consulting and engineering services**][25] and some of the
  [**projects**][26] our clients have developed with our help.

## Advanced Control Design

We provide consultancy to our clients over the entire MPC design process: problem formulation,
modeling, system identification, constraints definition, and weights calibration.

## Fast optimization

Our state-of-the-art optimization library enables fast and reliable execution of MPC systems in
real-time, together with tools for in-depth performance analysis and troubleshooting.

## Simple Integration

We provide library-free, ANSI C code that our clients can easily integrate into their software and
use in desktop pc or deploy in embedded platforms.

## Why using MPC

Model predictive control has a long history of success in the process industries. It is a universal,
advanced process control methodology to achieve the best closed-loop performance under constraints
by optimally coordinating multiple inputs. Compared to more classical methods such as single PID’s,
anti-windup schemes, and look-up tables, MPC is better suited to deal with **constrained**,
**multivariable systems**. Also, MPC can provide good **resilience** in case of **actuator
failure**. In our experience, the **time to market** of MPC-based products is usually shorter than
with traditional controls.

**[ODYS Embedded MPC][27]** allows our clients to develop advanced MPC systems also for
**high-frequency and/or embedded applications**, such as those that can be encountered in
automotive, aerospace, and robotics.

## Application Domains
* [Automotive][28]
* [Aerospace][29]
* [Robotics][30]
* [Energy][31]
* [Process Control][32]

We help automotive engineers developing advanced control systems based on **embedded MPC** and
**machine learning**.

We have experience in **ADAS**, **autonomous driving**, **motion control**, **powertrain
control**, **vehicle dynamics**, **valet parking**, **exhaust aftertreatment**, **on-board
diagnostics (OBD)**, and more.

[Embedded MPC for next-gen controls]
We design advanced real-time software tools for **guidance, navigation, and control** in the space
industry. Applications include satellite attitude control, space rendezvous, and autonomous
navigation of drones.
[Embedded MPC for next-gen controls]
Our tools can be used for a wide range of applications in the robotics domain, from low-level
**motor control** to high-level **position and force control**, and **motion planning** for
**autonomous platforms**.
[Embedded MPC for next-gen controls]
We design real-time management systems that can control **power flows** in **smart grids** and place
bids on the **energy markets**, to maximize profits in a risk-sensitive way under uncertainty due to
load, energy prices, and renewables.
[Embedded MPC for next-gen controls]
Process engineers in the pulp and paper, steel, petrochemical, and pharmaceutical industries take
advantage of our know-how in embedded MPC to develop customized process control solutions that
**optimize productivity** and **save energy** under the best use of available resources.

### What is Veeva QualityOne?

## A unified quality management software platform

Veeva QualityOne accelerates the delivery of high-quality products. Our cloud platform unifies QMS,
 HACCP, document control, and training workflows.

Brands, suppliers, manufacturers, and partners collaborate efficiently in a single, connected,
validated environment.

[ Explore the Product [veeva white cross arrow] ][38]

### Unify quality processes

Connect data and workflows in one validated quality management platform to ensure total consistency
and visibility across your teams, sites, and supply chain.

### Collaborate with partners

Share secure access to documents and quality workflows with your suppliers, CMOs, 3PLs, and
distributors, streamlining collaboration while ensuring global visibility and audit readiness.

### Support proactive quality

Leverage Veeva AI and real-time dashboards to identify risks across your global network and sharpen
executive decision-making.

## What Is TinyTask?

A microscopic automation tool that punches well above its weight class

TinyTask is a minimalist macro recording program for Windows that lets you capture mouse movements,
clicks, and keyboard input, then play them back on demand. Developed by Vista Software in the United
States, this freeware utility has earned a devoted following for one standout reason: the entire
application fits inside a single 36-kilobyte executable. That is not a typo. The whole program is
smaller than most favicon images.

Sponsored Links

The current version, TinyTask 1.77, works on every Windows release from XP through Windows 11.
Because it is written in pure C with zero external dependencies, there is nothing to install, no
.NET framework to worry about, and no registry entries to clean up later. You download the EXE,
double-click it, and the toolbar appears. That is the full setup process.

### Who Is TinyTask For?

If you do the same mouse-and-keyboard sequence more than twice a day, TinyTask can handle it for
you. Common use cases include filling out repetitive web forms, clicking through multi-step
workflows in business applications, automating file-rename sequences, and even handling basic game
actions. Data-entry workers, students, office administrators, and casual gamers all use TinyTask to
save time on tasks they would rather not do by hand.

### Why It Stays Popular

Plenty of macro recorders exist, but most of them run 50 MB or larger, require admin privileges, and
need a learning curve before you can record anything. TinyTask skips all of that. The toolbar shows
exactly what you need: record, play, stop, loop count, speed slider, open, save, and compile-to-EXE.
No menus, no preferences dialogs, no plugin systems. If your automation needs are straightforward –
click here, type that, repeat 200 times – TinyTask does the job without burning RAM or disk space.

TinyTask records your actions into a compact .rec file that you can share with coworkers or compile
into a standalone .exe so anyone can run it without installing TinyTask first.

The source code is not publicly available, but the freeware license allows unlimited personal and
commercial use at no cost. Vista Software distributes TinyTask through this site, thetinytask.com,
in both EXE and ZIP formats. Other domains advertising “official TinyTask downloads” (including
tinytask.net, tinytask.app, and tinytaski.com) aren’t affiliated with Vista Software, so if you
landed here from a search result that promised an “official 1.78” build or anything similar, you’ve
already dodged the lookalike traffic.

Everything you need for basic automation, packed into 36 kilobytes

positions.

Set a custom repeat count or run your macro in a continuous loop until you manually stop it. The

that repeat hundreds of times without variation.

A built-in speed slider lets you play macros faster or slower than the original recording speed.

## Getting Started with TinyTask

From first download to your first automated workflow in under five minutes

### Downloading TinyTask

Head over to our [download section][17] and grab TinyTask 1.77 directly. You will find two options:

is the most popular because you can run it immediately after downloading – no extraction step
required.

If your browser or antivirus flags the download, that is a false positive triggered by the small
file size and the fact that TinyTask hooks into mouse and keyboard input (which is exactly how it

The ZIP format is handy when you want to store TinyTask inside a folder with its .rec macro files,

Because it is portable, you can move it later without breaking anything.

### Launching TinyTask for the First Time

3. Windows will remember your choice, so this prompt only appears once

## Getting Started with TinyTask

From first download to your first automated workflow in under five minutes

1

### Downloading TinyTask

Head over to our [download section][17] and grab TinyTask 1.77 directly. You will find two options:
a standalone EXE file and a ZIP archive. Both contain the exact same 36 KB program. The EXE option
is the most popular because you can run it immediately after downloading – no extraction step
required.

If your browser or antivirus flags the download, that is a false positive triggered by the small
file size and the fact that TinyTask hooks into mouse and keyboard input (which is exactly how it
records macros). We will address how to handle that in the next step.

The ZIP format is handy when you want to store TinyTask inside a folder with its .rec macro files,
or if your workplace blocks direct EXE downloads. Simply extract the archive to any folder and you
are ready to go. At 36 KB, the download completes almost instantly on any connection.

**Tip:** Save TinyTask.exe somewhere easy to reach – your Desktop or a dedicated “Tools” folder.
Because it is portable, you can move it later without breaking anything.

2

### Launching TinyTask for the First Time

Double-click the TinyTask.exe file. There is no installer – the toolbar window appears within a
fraction of a second. On Windows 10 and Windows 11, you may see a Windows SmartScreen warning that
says “Windows protected your PC.” This happens because TinyTask is not digitally signed with a paid
code-signing certificate.

To get past SmartScreen:
1. Click **“More info”** in the SmartScreen dialog (the text is small and easy to miss)
2. Click **“Run anyway”** to launch the program
3. Windows will remember your choice, so this prompt only appears once

When TinyTask opens, you will see a compact horizontal toolbar with about 10 small buttons. From
left to right, the buttons are: Open, Save, Record (red circle), Play (green triangle), Stop,
Compile to EXE, Loop Count spinner, Speed slider, Minimize, and Always on Top pin. That toolbar is
the entire application. There are no hidden menus, no settings screen, and no splash window.

**Warning:** If TinyTask fails to launch at all, right-click the EXE and choose “Run as
administrator.” Some locked-down work environments require elevated privileges for programs that
hook into keyboard and mouse input.

3

– and you want to automate it so a coworker can run the same sequence later.
1. Click the **red Record button** on the TinyTask toolbar (or press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+R). The button
   will stay pressed to show that recording is active.
2. Open the Start Menu, type **“Notepad”**, and press Enter to launch it.
3. Type your text – for example, *“Monthly report – March 2026”*.
4. Press Ctrl+S, choose a save location, type the filename, and click Save.
5. Click the **Stop button** on TinyTask (or press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+R again to toggle recording off).

Your macro is now stored in memory. To play it back, click the **green Play button** or press
Ctrl+Shift+Alt+P. TinyTask will repeat every mouse movement and keystroke you recorded, in the same
order, at the same pace. Keep your hands off the mouse and keyboard during playback – any input from
you will interfere with the replay.

To save the macro to a file, click the **Save button** (floppy disk icon). TinyTask saves recordings
in its .rec format. You can share this file with anyone who has TinyTask, or you can compile it into
a standalone EXE using the Compile button.
